```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(apply)).

main :-
    read_line_to_string(user_input, Line),
    ( Line == end_of_file -> true
    ; split_string(Line, " \t\n\r", " \t\n\r", Parts),
      member(S, Parts), S \== "" ->
        number_string(N, S),
        count_nqueens(N, Ans),
        format("~d~n", [Ans])
    ; true
    ).

count_nqueens(N, Ans) :-
    length(Cols, N), maplist(=(0), Cols),
    D1N is 2*N-1, length(D1s, D1N), maplist(=(0), D1s),
    length(D2s, D1N), maplist(=(0), D2s),
    State = state(0),
    solve(0, N, Cols, D1s, D2s, State),
    arg(1, State, Ans).

solve(R, N, _, _, _, State) :- R =:= N, !,
    arg(1, State, A0), A1 is A0 + 1, nb_setarg(1, State, A1).
solve(R, N, Cols, D1s, D2s, State) :-
    between(0, N1, C), N1 is N - 1,
    nth0(C, Cols, 0),
    I1 is R + C, nth0(I1, D1s, 0),
    I2 is R - C + N - 1, nth0(I2, D2s, 0),
    nb_setnth(C, Cols, 1),
    nb_setnth(I1, D1s, 1),
    nb_setnth(I2, D2s, 1),
    R1 is R + 1,
    solve(R1, N, Cols, D1s, D2s, State),
    nb_setnth(C, Cols, 0),
    nb_setnth(I1, D1s, 0),
    nb_setnth(I2, D2s, 0),
    fail.
solve(_, _, _, _, _, _).

nb_setnth(I, L, V) :- nth0(I, L, _, R), nb_setnth_(R, V).
nb_setnth_(L, V) :- L = [_|T], nb_setarg(1, L, V), T = T.
```
